scope.authorized: Full offline byte/frame/record audit; real answer3 -> close -> answer2 provenance anchor; metadata-only full MCP catalogue/schema classification.

offlineSession.method: Full JSON grammar parse preserving every object key/value, duplicate keys, object key order, array order, string values and number lexemes; no persistence/codec/provenance parser; no field filtering or normalization. Raw JSONL comparisons separately retained. Canonical hashes sort object keys only; arrays and scalar lexemes unchanged.

decoder.method: Native decoder advanced by engine.bytesWritten until entire input consumed. Independently partition every zstd magic candidate; each exact segment must decompress and consume fully. Both boundary sequences and combined outputs must match. No finishFlush, truncation, repair or persistence open.

classification.businessHistory: All original ordered records, user/assistant texts, tool calls/results, lifecycle receipts, IDs, numeric lexemes, times, C/I/KN and both bindings are unchanged. Sole extra record is the resume marker.
